# Test fixtures

`seville.geojson` holds six real segments from the Overture Maps `2026-09-23.1` release, chosen
because each shows one rule-evaluation case (see `../vectors/seville.json`). It was written by
`overrules export` and is regenerated with `just fixtures`.
